capabilities: Edit mind map nodes with keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop reparenting, undo/redo and collapse
Switch between the mind map canvas and the native Markdown editor
Show canvas and source side by side with live two-way sync
Insert wikilinks and embeds with in-node autocomplete and hover preview
Export maps to PNG, SVG, JPEG or WebP at 1x/2x/3x resolution
extras: Distributed through BRAT as early access while awaiting community plugin approval; README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and notes a Chinese IME conflict with the Ctrl+. shortcut.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and edit a note as an interactive mind map while keeping it as plain Markdown.
summary: Mind map editor that stores maps as standard Markdown headings and nested lists, with one-click switching between the map canvas and source view.
